title: Maps, Sets and JSON
description:
Write four functions:

```javascript
function wordFrequencies(text) { }   // a Map from lower-case word to count, in first-seen order
function topWords(text, n) { }       // the n most frequent words as [word, count] pairs; ties keep first-seen order
function saveState(state) { }        // JSON text for { tags: Set, scores: Map, name } that loadState can read back
function loadState(text) { }         // the original shape: a Set, a Map and the name
```

Words are runs of letters and apostrophes (`/[a-z']+/g` on the lower-case text).
hints: `text.toLowerCase().match(/[a-z']+/g)` returns an array of every run of letters and apostrophes, such as `["the", "cat"]` (the `/.../g` is a regular expression; lesson 7.01 explains them). It returns `null` when nothing matches; `?? []` turns that into an empty list.
`JSON.stringify` writes a Map or Set as `{}`. Convert them first with `[...set]` and `Object.fromEntries(map)`, then rebuild them after `JSON.parse`.
